_doc: Autonomous edge engine config. live=false => dry-run only (logs candidates, places NOTHING). Flip live=true to let it bet within the caps. Lane modes: 'bet' = real maker orders, 'log' = record to scorecard only (measure, no money), 'alert' = notify only. ENVELOPE: Aggressive, set by Rich 2026-06-04. (A one-off cap bump on 2026-06-10 was reverted same day -- caps change on a rule, not on a post-win impulse.)
_coverage_doc: COVERAGE (Rich 2026-06-25: 'we never needed to pay for odds API, adjust what we have'). Set to 1 = single-book (free ESPN/DraftKings) is allowed again -- the original soccer bleed was single-book LONGSHOTS, and those are now killed independently by the win-prob floor (favorites only), the 68c payout ceiling, single_book_max_edge (15pt stale cap), and one-bet-per-game. So single-book can only produce geometry-protected FAVORITE bets, not the longshots that bled. Multi-book consensus (>= sharp_min_books via the cached Odds API free tier) still earns the tighter min_abs_edge_prob_sharp floor as a BONUS when credits are available -- but the engine no longer STARVES without it. No paid feed needed.
_winrate_doc: WIN-RATE MAINTENANCE CONTROLLER. The engine only takes a sharp-lane bet if the model gives that side >= an effective win-prob floor. floor = win_floor_base + win_floor_gain*(target_win_rate - realized_hit_rate), clamped [base, max]. So if the realized hit rate dips below target it AUTO-TIGHTENS (demands stronger favorites -> rate climbs back); when we're above target it relaxes to base for more volume. min_fair_prob_sharp is the live floor the engine overwrites each run. FIXED 2026-06-15: the floor now applies to EVERY sharp-lane bet (and the press lane), not just multi-book ones -- the old 'if sharp and' clause let single-book longshots (the whole World Cup slate, since Odds API has 0 WC coverage) bypass it, which flipped the record green->red 6/11..6/14. win_floor_max lowered 0.86->0.80 so a bad run tightens hard to 80%+ favorites without choking volume to zero.
_sharp_doc: When a sharp number is a multi-book CONSENSUS (>= sharp_min_books books via The Odds API), trust a smaller gap (min_abs_edge_prob_sharp) -- a single-book de-vig still needs the wider 3pt floor. A single book also gets a HARD edge ceiling (single_book_max_edge): one book claiming a giant gap is stale/wrong both ways (a fake longshot AND a fake favorite), so only a consensus is trusted for big edges. min_bet_contracts kills 1-contract dust. The net-EV-after-fee floor still applies to every bet.
_watchdog_doc: SELF-HEALING WATCHDOG v2 (Rich 2026-06-15: 'flip it on'). watchdog.py runs */30 on e5; when watchdog_autopatch=true it ACTS, not just memos. BRAKES: quarantines a bleeding COVERED segment (win-rate below floor, enough volume) for watchdog_quarantine_hours, auto-lifting when it recovers -- a BLIND bleeder needs no quarantine (the no-coverage gate already skips it). GAS: a bounded, time-boxed lean-in (watchdog_lean_in_mult) on a proven hot COVERED segment, still clamped to conviction_max_usd = under the hard ceiling. auto_edge reads data/watchdog_state.json and obeys. Every action lands in a CEO memo at e5-mother/watchdog.html + Slack.
_conviction_doc: CONVICTION-WEIGHTED SIZING (Rich 2026-06-15: 'if the logic supports it, place a bigger bet -- be adaptive in a good way too, don't limit yourself'). Replaces flat $8-on-everything: stake scales with edge size + multi-book consensus strength + favorite safety, between conviction_min_usd and conviction_max_usd. conviction_max_usd (12) is ABOVE the old flat per_bet_max (8) on purpose -- a monster well-covered edge bets bigger. The HARD governor (daily_max_usd, total_exposure_max_usd, min_balance_floor_usd, kill switch) still bounds everything = ruin prevention (the XLM lesson). per_bet_max_usd is now the dry-run/longshot reference; live sizing is conviction-driven.
_favlongshot_doc: GEOMETRY FIX (Rich 2026-06-15: 'not a fan of these 75c wins, they don't cover the $1 when they lose'). Cap lowered 92->70: never buy a favorite richer than 70c, so a WIN is worth >=30c instead of pennies (8c at 92c). At 92c one loss wiped ~11 wins -- upside-down. This lane stays small + grind-only; the real volume should come from balanced multi-book sharp edges, not penny favorites.
_press_doc: PRESS lane (2026-06-10, Rich's idea): double-down on an OPEN bet with LOCKED daily profit, only where it STILL shows fresh real edge at the live ask, capped so the night stays net-green. Funded from profit, never principal. Starts in 'log' mode (proves it flags the right spots, spends nothing) -- flip to 'bet' to go live.
